column1: # SHIPPED: read by LexiconHazardTagger (hazard_model.py) since model 0.2.0.
# Context cues that make a MILD heat term (severity <= 2, e.g. "umiinit",
# "init") a comfort or feature remark rather than a hazard report.
# PROVENANCE AND ITS LIMIT. Derived by inspecting ALL 26 false-positive safety
# sentences from labelling round 1. There is therefore NO held-out sample: any
# precision measured on round 1 after applying these cues is in-sample and
# optimistic. Treat it as the ceiling of what these rules can do, not as an
# estimate of field performance. Confirming the gain requires a fresh labelled
# round on sentences these rules have never seen.
# Suppression applies ONLY when the strongest safety term in the segment has
# severity <= 2. Strong evidence (sunog, usok, sumabog, pumutok, spark,
# grounded, bloated battery) is never suppressed by a cue.
# ---------- worn on the body: heat is a comfort complaint ----------
